_why: sha256 of resources/octobots-pack/graph/octograph.mjs, keyed by the OCTOBOTS_PACK_VERSION its banner carries. graphStatus decides an INSTALLED payload is stale by comparing that number and nothing else, but the payload is machine-generated from packages/graph: a source change there regenerates different bytes under the SAME version, so every workspace that already installed graph would report `current` forever and never be prompted to upgrade. test/graph-payload.test.ts turns that silence into a red test: change packages/graph, and you must bump OCTOBOTS_PACK_VERSION (and the pack's other markers) and add the new entry below. Rewriting an existing entry's hash instead is allowed, but it is a visible diff line a reviewer can challenge - which is the point.
